findings.title: Caste/Category Eligibility
findings.summary: Possibly outdated: the only evidence belongs to an earlier cycle than 2026–27.
findings.value: Students belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC) are eligible for this scholarship. (from 2020–21)

sources.value: Students belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC) are eligible for this scholarship.
sources.quote: SCHEME OF POST MATRIC SCHOLARSHIPS TO THE STUDENTS BELONGING TO SCHEDULED CASTES FOR STUDIES IN INDIA (PMS-SC)

findings.note: It would be wise to verify the latest caste/category eligibility criteria to ensure you meet the requirements for the 2026–27 cycle.

findings.title: Family Income Limit
findings.summary: Potential gap: none of the 2 analysed source(s) mention family income limit.
findings.note: You should confirm the current family income limit as this is often a key eligibility factor for scholarships.

findings.title: Domicile Requirement
findings.summary: Possibly outdated: the only evidence belongs to an earlier cycle than 2026–27.
findings.value: Applicant must be permanently settled or domiciled in the State/UT. (from 2020–21)

sources.value: Applicant must be permanently settled or domiciled in the State/UT.
sources.quote: the State Government/Union Territory to which the applicant actually belongs (i.e. the State/UT in which permanently settled or domiciled, as per the terms of domicile decided by the State).

findings.note: It is advisable to check the specific domicile requirements for Madhya Pradesh for the current scholarship cycle.

findings.title: Application Portal/Website
findings.summary: Supported by 1 source(s); strongest: NSP : National Scholarship Portal (Primary).
findings.value: Applications are submitted on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

sources.value: Applications are submitted on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).
sources.quote: OTR is required to apply for the scholarships on National Scholarship Portal from AY 2024-25.

findings.note: Ensure you apply through the official National Scholarship Portal (NSP) to avoid fraudulent websites.

findings.title: Academic Qualification Criteria
findings.summary: Possibly outdated: the only evidence belongs to an earlier cycle than 2026–27.
findings.value: Scholarship is for studies at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage. (from 2020–21)

sources.value: Scholarship is for studies at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage.
sources.quote: by providing financial assistance at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education.

findings.note: It is recommended to confirm the academic qualification criteria to ensure your undergraduate status aligns with the scholarship's requirements.
